title: Israel’s President Could Play Key Role in Breaking Post-Election Deadlock
summary_full: President Isaac Herzog has tried to avoid controversy and heal rifts in his largely ceremonial role. But his skills as a savvy mediator could be instrumental after an inconclusive election.
